title: Plan migration from version 2.4
summary: Identify compatibility changes and migrate a retired Northstar configuration to a maintained release.

sections.title: Migration considerations
paragraphs: Version 2.4 is retired. Export channel configuration, capture register consumers, and test scaling against version 3.0 or later before replacement.
steps: Inventory channel types, scaling, consumers, and credentials.
Export configuration and verify the backup can be parsed.
Map changed registers and authentication behavior.
Rehearse migration with a simulated or spare gateway.
Schedule cutover with a tested rollback plan.
